meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.

howto.what: 把指定的 NanoClaw agent group 从 Anthropic API 切到本机 Ollama 模型:改写 container.json 里的 env 和 blockedHosts、在共享 settings.json 中设置模型名,再重建并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你想把某个 agent 跑在本地、省 API 费用,或试用开放权重模型时使用。前提是主机已装好并运行 Ollama、模型已 pull、目标 agent group 已存在。

say.text: 把这个 agent 改回 Anthropic API

howto.what_en: Routes a chosen NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: it edits container.json env and blockedHosts, sets the model in the shared settings.json, then rebuilds and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to run an agent locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama installed and running on the host, the model already pulled, and the agent group to exist.

say_en.text: Route agent group <folder> to the local Ollama <model>.
say_en.note: Edits container.json, then restarts the service.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are available on this host?
say_en.note: Lists models already pulled on the host.

say_en.text: Switch this agent back to the Anthropic API.
say_en.note: Removes env, blockedHosts and model, then restarts.
